'''Adapted Bolsters''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Adapted Parasites|Adapted]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
* Spawns after a [[Primitive Bolster]] accumulates a killcount of 30 and [[Evolution System|evolves]].
* Spawns naturally in groups of 2 to 3, if [[Ubiquitous Development]] is Level 3 or higher, with a spawnweight of 15.
* Spawns inside the [[Parasite Biome]], with a spawnweight of 10.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Adapted Bolsters Slow moving, Tank and Support units and devastating AoE Melee combatants. 

* Adapted Bolster's Melee Attack inflicts AoE Damage and is performed by them swinging their scythes.
*If the [[Generations|Generation]] is 4 or higher, Adapted Bolsters can perform the following abilities:
**An AoE Barrage. It will stay still during this attack, flailing its tentacles inflicting very high damage per second, ignoring immunity frames, and pulling the targets around.
*** This is telegraphed by flame particles and a significantly louder and higher pitched growl. They will also stand still before performing this attack.
**Giving Regeneration IV (1:00) to nearby Parasites that are up to 24 blocks away with a cooldown of 60 seconds.
**Like other Adapted land Parasites, vomit [[Residue]] in a 7x7 area every so often.
* Adapted Bolsters can perform small leaps in liquids.
* Adapted Bolsters can sink in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
* Adapted Bolsters can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 3.5, with a 20 ticks cooldown and 2 Blocks range.
{{Variants|count=3|Berserker=BerserkerAdaBolster.png|Virulent=VirulentAdaBolster.png|Breacher=BreacherAdaBolster.png}}

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
* Adapted Bolsters, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
* Adapted Bolsters' Tendrils, found on the sides of their body, can reset their [[Adaptation System|adaptation]], while also giving them the [[Bleeding]] and [[Rage]] Effects.

=== ''Post Death'' ===
* On death, Adapted Bolsters have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Adapted Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].
** If at least one [[Colony]] exists in the dimension, Adapted Bolsters will become [[Primitive Bolster|Primitive Bolsters]] upon death instead.

== ''Trivia'' ==
*Bolsters are called '''Bano''' and '''Zetmo''' seemingly interchangeably in the mod files, rather this is a mistake or not is unknown.
**'''Zetmo''' was the Bolster's name in early betas, which would match the naming convention used by other adapteds.
**Sometimes these names are combined into '''Bano e'Zetmo''', such as in the Compendium.
*To "bolster" something means to support or strengthen it, which may reference the Bolster's tankiness and ability to give Regeneration to other parasites.
